The predecessor baseline remains byte-frozen historical evidence. The v0.9.1 immutable UI artifact is a new implementation build over the retained Color Set; it does not relabel or replace the predecessor baseline.

## Implementation examples

- Shared Locale Insight architecture across Land, Location, and Living while product data, methods, claims, terminology, and capabilities stay product-specific.
- Initial HTML, visible page, and hydrated state preserve the same claim, source, time basis, and limitation.
- Navigation uses direct named destinations, a disclosure button with stable focus recovery, and separate current-page/current-location states.
- Icons remain rounded outline at FILL 0 in every state.
- Motion is role-gated, finite, and fail-open; answers, evidence, actions, deep links, and focus targets are visible without motion or JavaScript.
- Web, PDF, deck, and social outputs preserve semantic meaning rather than pixel sameness.
- Incompatibility is a valid result when schema, release, unit, or grain differs.

## Evidence and capability boundaries

- All teaching cases on this page are conceptual unless a named product-specific adaptation says otherwise.
- This reference is not evidence about a city, place, product, audience, or outcome.
- It is not a Full Living Reference.
- Cross-product or cross-city comparison requires a compatible schema and release, with unit and grain reconciled; otherwise the incompatibility must remain visible.
- CityMETER, CityWiki, CityChat, ijji, municipality, retail, F&B, land-valuation, flood, and other named-product or domain assumptions must not be generalized to the shared Landometer layer.
- The Complete Color Atlas is a design reference. A product analysis must bind its own compatible data release and evidence before using analytical scales.
- The page does not save, share, invite, publish, track, or mutate a remote governed object.

## Machine-use rules

- Preserve object ID, version, scope, boundary, time, source, missingness, confidence, limitation, allowed use, visibility, and authoritative state.
- Never upgrade partial to complete, modelled to observed, planned to available, sent to received, a handoff to a network effect, or discovery to evidence.
- Readability does not grant permission to act.
- Do not infer an action endpoint from a human-facing link or control.
- Do not infer that the Design System release pre-certifies a downstream artifact or product claim.

This project-path llms.txt is a navigation aid only. It is not a ranking signal, crawler directive, access-control rule, conformance certificate, or permission for an agent to act.
